I want the music one, obviously, because I already play a bit. The thing is, Tuesday is the day I go to my cousin's house, so the two things... how do you say it when two things are on the same day and you cannot do both? Anyway. That. So maybe the film club is more sensible. I am not sure, but I think I am going to choose the film one and be sad about it. What would you do?

Here is the thing I tell every student, and almost nobody believes me at first. The slowest possible way to speak another language is to build the sentence in your own language and then translate it. It is slow, it sounds strange, and while you are doing it, the conversation moves on without you. So when a word is missing, do not stop. Describe it. Say what it does, or what it is like, or where you find it. The other person will give you the word, and you will remember it forever. And about mistakes: a sentence with a mistake in it still works. Silence does not.
